doctrine.title: Series 2 Download: Consolidated Operating Doctrine

proposal_architecture.source: 2Bobs (Blair Enns + David Baker), ProposalPhi, HubSpot/Agency Training
proposal_architecture.core_principle: Three-option proposals are three distinct engagement models, not scope size tiers. Each option represents a different risk allocation between client and firm.

three_option_framework.inputs_based: Client pays for time and effort. Firm carries delivery risk. Lowest price, highest client involvement in scope definition.
three_option_framework.outputs_based: Client pays for defined deliverables. Shared risk. Mid-tier. Most common.
three_option_framework.outcomes_based: Client pays for results. Firm carries all execution risk. Highest price. Rare. Most powerful anchor.

proposal_architecture.common_mistake: Most practitioners treat options as 'good/better/best' scope escalation only. This is the entry-level error. Real architecture changes who owns the risk.

anchoring_mechanics.extremeness_aversion: Buyers avoid the cheapest and most expensive options. Middle option gets selected most often.
anchoring_mechanics.starbucks_doctrine: Starbucks removed 'Short' from visible menu. 'Tall' became the minimum. Average purchase shifted upward to 'Grande.' Apply: never lead with your lowest option. Anchor up.
anchoring_mechanics.price_anchor_placement: Lead with the highest option to establish ceiling. Middle becomes reference point. Low option validates the others.

sequence: 1. Emotional foundation before document. Discovery call builds trust; proposal closes it.
2. Clear objections before cost is revealed, not after.
3. Proposal is a plan anchor (promise, phases, logistics), not a sales tool.
4. Budget conversation happens in discovery, not in proposal review.

four_cs_framework.customer: Willingness to pay ceiling. Research via voice-of-customer.
four_cs_framework.company: Positioning signal. Price is a brand statement.
four_cs_framework.competition: Anchor reference only. Do not compete on price.

pricing_psychology.value_based_pricing_rule: Price at 10-80% of documented revenue impact. Capture more as track record grows.
pricing_psychology.saas_10_5_20_rule: Raise price after 10 customers, 5% rejection rate, 20% churn signal. Same principle applies to service pricing.
pricing_psychology.price_as_product_signal: Price is positioning. Low price signals low confidence. Raise price before you think you are ready.
pricing_psychology.price_increase_trigger: Raise price when 20% of prospects say no due to price. Below 20% means you are underpriced.
pricing_psychology.freelancer_rate_progression: Day rate increases when output doubles, not when time passes. 2x output threshold unlocks 2x rate.
pricing_psychology.price_as_permission: Charging higher creates implementation void. Client invests more because stakes are higher. Low price kills client motivation.
pricing_psychology.tithe_principle: Give a percentage of income away. Breaks emotional money attachment. Enables cleaner pricing decisions.
pricing_psychology.herding_effect_warning: 70%+ of Airbnb operators using same pricing software creates race-to-middle. Differentiate by not following the herd default.

sales_and_discovery.core_doctrine: Scientific discovery trumps generic sales technique. Consultative diagnosis precedes selling. Belief reframing beats script recitation.

care_objection_framework.C: Clarify - repeat the objection back exactly
care_objection_framework.A: Ask + Isolate - is this the only objection?
care_objection_framework.R: Reframe - recontextualize the objection from their worldview
care_objection_framework.E: Empower - return choice to them without pressure

sales_and_discovery.adbq_reframe: Answer, Deflect, Bridge, Question. Never answer objections head-on. Bridge to underlying concern, then question.
sales_and_discovery.financial_qualification_gate: Three data points before presenting price: (1) current spend in category, (2) budget authority (who else decides), (3) consequence of not solving (cost of inaction).
discovery_sequence: 1. Establish emotional safety before technical questions.
3. Surface pain at three levels: surface, business impact, personal consequence.
4. Get explicit verbal agreement on problem before solution.
5. Present investment after agreement, never before.
sales_and_discovery.identity_based_closing: Close on identity alignment, not transaction. 'This is the kind of person you want to be' beats 'here is what you get.'
sales_and_discovery.partner_coaching_rule: When two decision-makers: coach your champion to handle the second decision-maker before the follow-up call. Never present to a split room unprepared.
sales_and_discovery.fluid_framework_rule: Frameworks are maps. Discovery is terrain. When terrain contradicts map, follow terrain.

foundation_sequence: 1. Story, message, and avatar lock BEFORE content tactics.
3. Identity built from inside out: beliefs, values, story, rituals first. Style and appearance last.
4. Journey POV is sufficient authority. Do not wait for credentialed expertise.
personal_brand_and_content.chris_doe_11_part_brand_asset_framework: Authenticity comes from mastered skill expressed through consistent values. Brand assets: (1) origin story, (2) belief system, (3) contrarian POV, (4) recurring formats, (5) vocabulary/language, (6) visual identity, (7) rituals, (8) community rituals, (9) enemies/antagonists, (10) sacred cows you kill, (11) recurring characters.
personal_brand_and_content.content_machine_loop: YouTube views to email list to call to close. Each platform has one job. Do not mix awareness and conversion surfaces.
personal_brand_and_content.3_1_2_1_weekly_ratio: 3 attract posts, 1 nurture post, 2 position posts, 1 convert post per week.
personal_brand_and_content.ai_at_70_human_at_30: AI handles script polish, formatting, repurposing. Human provides voice, perspective, original insight. Invert this and the brand dies.
personal_brand_and_content.flopping_weekly_rule: If you are not flopping content weekly, you are not experimenting enough. Flops are data.
personal_brand_and_content.batching_discipline: Template + batch + repurpose. Consistency at scale only works with batching architecture.
personal_brand_and_content.seth_godin_purple_cow_application: Remarkable = worth remarking about. If it is not remarkable, more distribution will not fix it. Positioning requires selective association; being associated with everyone means being associated with no one.
personal_brand_and_content.gary_vee_macro_micro_rule: Macro patience (years), micro speed (daily). Post every day. Care about none of the posts. Care about the body of work.
personal_brand_and_content.movement_building_equation: Movement = shared enemy + shared belief + insider language + recurring ritual.
personal_brand_and_content.authenticity_moat: Authenticity is defensible because it cannot be copied at scale. AI copies format; it cannot copy lived experience.
personal_brand_and_content.value_ladder_mechanics: Gift (free) to Prospect (low-cost) to Core (main offer) to Client (premium/retained). Each rung qualifies for the next.
personal_brand_and_content.reciprocity_mechanics: Give first, give consistently, give without extraction signals. Reciprocity triggers without being demanded.

premium_positioning_framework: 1. Attributes: what makes this distinctly different
2. Value: what that difference means for the buyer
3. Who cares and why: exact ICP with exact motivation
positioning_and_premium_market.niche_clarity_rule: Premium buyers pay for specificity. Generalists compete on price. Specialists set price.
positioning_and_premium_market.voice_of_customer_research: Use customer language exactly. Do not paraphrase. Mirror language = trust signal.

copywriting_funnel_stages.TOFU: Attract with problem identification. Never mention your offer.
copywriting_funnel_stages.MOFU: Nurture with solution framework. Position your methodology.
copywriting_funnel_stages.BOFU: Convert with proof and offer. Urgency is earned, not manufactured.

daniel_priestley_5p_framework.pitching: Capstone framework: IP-named methodology that travels without you
daniel_priestley_5p_framework.publishing: 7-11-4 rule: 7 hours of content, 11 touchpoints, 4 locations before a buyer trusts enough to buy
daniel_priestley_5p_framework.profile: SALT audit: Seen (visibility), Authority (proof), Liked (resonance), Trusted (track record)
daniel_priestley_5p_framework.partnership: Multiply game: every partnership should multiply reach, not add it

positioning_and_premium_market.sell_before_build: Validate via waiting list or deposit before production. Never build speculatively without signal.
positioning_and_premium_market.category_strategy_rule: Do not be first mover. Be second or third mover in a validated category with superior execution.
positioning_and_premium_market.brand_independence_principle: Brand must survive without founder as face. Build IP, frameworks, and community that outlast any single creator.
positioning_and_premium_market.founder_led_branding: Early stage: founder IS the brand. Use personal credibility as distribution channel. Mid-stage: transition to IP and community. Late stage: brand carries itself.
positioning_and_premium_market.saying_no_discipline: Every yes is a no to something else. Cadence founder (Ross McKay) built to 9-figure scale by saying no to distribution partners who would have diluted the brand. Selective distribution = brand protection.

team_staging.solo_to_2: Hire for your drudgery zone first. Time freed = capacity for revenue-generating activity.
team_staging.2_to_12: Hire people who fit the stage, not the destination. Stage-fit over credential-fit.
team_staging.12_plus: Systems and culture replace founder oversight. Document before delegating.

business_scaling.cash_flow_management: Revenue is vanity, cash flow is sanity. Know your runway in days, not months. Optimize for cash conversion speed, not total contract value.
business_scaling.proprietary_over_agency: Own your distribution, data, and creative output. Agency dependency is a ceiling.
business_scaling.founder_strength_leverage: Founder's job is vision and velocity, not execution of every domain. Protect the two; delegate the rest.
business_scaling.gut_qualified_by_expertise: Gut decisions are valid ONLY after deep domain expertise. Novice gut is noise. Expert gut is compressed pattern recognition.
business_scaling.consistency_over_novelty: Consistency in category, format, and frequency compounds. Novelty burns attention without building asset.

government_contracting_relevance.scope_budget_schedule_triangle: Fix one, the other two flex. Never fix all three without scope change order authority.
government_contracting_relevance.SMART_objectives: Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, Time-bound. Any deliverable without these is a scope dispute waiting to happen.
government_contracting_relevance.waterfall_vs_agile: Waterfall: fixed scope, fixed timeline. Agile: fixed cadence, flexible scope. Match methodology to client tolerance for ambiguity.

brand_deal_mechanics.baseline_rate: Negotiate per deliverable, not per campaign. Retain rights to repurpose.
brand_deal_mechanics.financial_planning_for_creator_transitio: Do not quit day job until creator income equals 6 months of expenses for 3 consecutive months.
brand_deal_mechanics.platform_timing: Publish when YOUR audience is active, not when platform suggests. Test 3 time windows for 30 days each.

youtube_creator_strategy.storytelling_hierarchy: Hook, conflict, resolution. Every video. Non-negotiable.
youtube_creator_strategy.editing_doctrine_hayden_oppenheimer: Edit for emotion, not information. Ruthless cut rate. If it does not serve the emotional arc, it goes.
youtube_creator_strategy.MrBeast_Logan_Paul_lesson: Thumbnail and title are the product. Content is the delivery mechanism for the next click.
youtube_creator_strategy.batching_at_scale: Batch record, batch edit, schedule release. Creator mental health depends on production buffer.

short_form_strategy.hook_in_3_seconds: If the first 3 seconds do not answer 'why should I watch this', the video is dead.
short_form_strategy.show_your_work: Transparent process content outperforms polished reveals. Show the decision, not just the outcome.
short_form_strategy.do_it_for_data: Launch imperfect. Collect data. Iterate. Perfectionism is procrastination with better branding.

creator_monetization.full_time_filmmaker_rbf_acquisition_less: Audience-first content businesses can be acquisition targets. Build for exits by building recurring audience behavior, not just follower count.

technical_doctrine.preset_and_wb_guidelines: Lock white balance to a custom Kelvin value per venue type. Consistent WB is the foundation for batch editing speed.
technical_doctrine.anticipate_recurring_moments: Every event has predictable peak moments. Pre-position for them. Do not chase; be where the moment is going.
technical_doctrine.quick_turnaround_discipline: Deliver within 24-48 hours for events. Speed is a competitive advantage that compounds via referrals and repeat bookings.
technical_doctrine.presets_as_operational_leverage: One consistent preset application per genre cuts post-processing time by 60-70%. Batch, do not touch individually.

concert_and_event_photography.relationship_over_technical_skill: In creative partnerships (bands, artists, athletes), personal relationship weight exceeds technical skill weight. Be the person they trust, then be the person they respect technically.
concert_and_event_photography.price_as_permission_application: Higher event photography rates filter out low-commitment clients who ghost, complain, and do not pay on time. Raise price; improve client quality.

operating_rules: Proposal options are risk models, not scope sizes. Three ways to work together, not three package sizes.
Lead with highest option. Anchor up. Extremeness aversion will pull buyers to the middle.
Price is a positioning signal. Raise price before you feel ready.
Price at 10-80% of documented revenue impact. Track record determines where in that range.
20% rejection rate on price means you are correctly priced. Below 20% means you are underpriced.
Diagnosis before prescription. Never present solution before explicit agreement on problem.
Clear objections before cost reveal, not after. Pre-proposal conversation is the real sale.
Identity-based closing beats transactional closing. Anchor on who the buyer wants to be.
Story, message, and avatar lock before content tactics. Never.
AI at 70% (polish, format, repurpose), human at 30% (voice, POV, original insight). Invert and brand dies.
7-11-4 rule: 7 hours content, 11 touchpoints, 4 locations before trust sufficient to buy.
Consistency in category, format, and frequency compounds. Novelty is noise.
Sell before build. Deposit or waitlist before production. No speculative builds.
Hire for drudgery zone first. Freed time = revenue-generating capacity.
Founder's job is vision and velocity. Delegate everything else.
Gut is valid only after expertise. Expert gut = compressed pattern recognition.
Batch record, batch edit, schedule release. Production buffer protects creative output quality.
Deliver fast. 24-48 hours for events. Speed compounds via referrals.
Personal relationship weight exceeds technical skill weight in creative partnerships.
Show your work. Transparent process content outperforms polished reveals.
Do it for data. Imperfect launch beats perfect non-launch.
Brand must outlast the founder. Build IP, frameworks, and community that travel without you.
Every proposal is a plan anchor, not a sales tool. Promise, phases, logistics.
Proposal budget conversation belongs in discovery, never in proposal review.
Saying no is brand protection. Every yes is a no to positioning clarity.

tools_noted: ChatGPT (data extraction, occupancy forecasting, script polish)
contradictions_flagged: Cost-based vs value-based pricing: both cited across segments. Resolution: cost is floor, value is ceiling. Never compete in between.
Price increase trigger: 5% rejection per 10 customers (one source) vs 20% rejection rate (Blair Enns). Use 20% as the validated threshold.
Free sauce vs paid courses positioning: Buff Bunny and others both cited. Resolution: free content builds trust, paid product converts it. No contradiction once value ladder is understood.
Slow macro planning vs fast micro execution: apparent contradiction resolves as Gary Vee macro/micro rule. Year-scale patience, day-scale speed.
